seoTitle: How to Enable or Disable Parallax Scrolling on Squarespace
metaDescription: Turn on the parallax scrolling effect for background images on Squarespace, or switch it back off, through the section background settings.
intro: Parallax scrolling makes background images move slower than the content in front of them, giving your site a sense of depth and a more modern feel. This guide shows how to turn the effect on for a section, and how to disable it again if it's not the look you want.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in at squarespace.com, using Continue with Google if your account is linked, and open the site you want to edit.

steps.heading: Open the section settings
steps.body: Click Edit on the page, hover over the section with the background image, and click Edit Section.

steps.heading: Find the Image Effect option
steps.body: In the section settings, click on Background, then look for the Image Effect option.

steps.heading: Select Parallax
steps.body: Choose Parallax from the image effect options to activate the scrolling effect on that section's background.

steps.heading: Disable it if needed
steps.body: To turn the effect off later, revisit the same settings and select None or another image effect, then click Save.

faq.question: Where do I find the parallax setting on Squarespace?
faq.answer: It's under the section's Background settings, in the Image Effect option, where you can select Parallax.

faq.question: Can I apply parallax to just one section instead of the whole page?
faq.answer: Yes, the parallax effect is set per section, so you can enable it on specific backgrounds while leaving others static.

faq.question: How do I turn off parallax scrolling?
faq.answer: Go back to the same Background settings and choose None or a different image effect, then save your changes.

faq.question: Do I need to save after changing the image effect?
faq.answer: Yes, changes won't apply until you click Save after selecting or removing the parallax effect.
